content: Grand Theft Auto 6 is somehow off to an even hotter start than many expected. The game sold 32.5 million copies pre-release, bringing in a whopping $3.79 billion on day one. That makes it the biggest entertainment launch in history, according to publisher Take-Two. Unfortunately, though, not everyone has been able to enjoy the fun. Numerous players have reported that they can't progress in the game due to a persistent PlayStation 5 crash that sends them back to the dashboard.
